title: Guest Folios Schedule of Correction Reasons and Correction Amounts
content:
**Form of a correction.** An adjustment on one of the Guest Folios of an Ashbury hotel corrects exactly one original folio line, names that line, and carries its charge code; when both a charge and its tax line are wrong, each is adjusted by its own adjustment. Each original line is adjusted at most once. The amount of the adjustment depends on its reason.

## Schedule of reasons

| Reason | Lines it applies to | Amount taken off |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate posting | A room, room tax, resort fee or resort fee tax line that repeats the charge code and business date of an earlier line on the same folio; or an incidental line that repeats the charge code, amount and business date of the line with the immediately preceding folio line number | The line in full |
| Incorrect rate | A room line that differs from the reservation's nightly rate, and its room tax line | The room line by the difference; its room tax line by the difference multiplied by the reservation's tax rate, rounded to the cent |
| Charge not incurred | A self-parking line at a brand whose resort fee includes self-parking; a pet fee for an animal the guest states is a service animal, where the brand exempts service animals; a breakfast line on a stay where breakfast is complimentary or part of the rate; a courtesy minibar removal within the courtesy minibar allowance | The line in full |
| Late charge outside the window | An incidental line posted later than the brand's late charge posting window after the actual check-out date | The line in full |
| Resort fee not applicable | A resort fee or resort fee tax line on a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation, or on a night after the actual check-out date | The line in full |
| Elite benefit not applied | A late check-out fee from which the stay is exempt under the late check-out elite exemption | The line in full |
| Early departure fee not applicable | An early departure fee that the early departure terms do not support | The line in full |

## Points of judgement

- **Duplicates differ by line type.** For room, room tax, resort fee and resort fee tax lines the test is the charge code and business date of any earlier line on the folio. For incidental lines the test is the charge code, amount and business date of the line with the immediately preceding folio line number; two identical restaurant lines that are not consecutive on the folio are not duplicates under this test.
- **Charge and its tax.** A wrong room line and its wrong room tax line are two adjustments, one naming each line.
- **One correction per line.** A line that already carries an adjustment is not adjusted again.

## Worked figures (hypothetical lines)

- **Incorrect rate.** A reservation's nightly rate is $189.00 and its tax rate 12%; a night's room line was posted at $219.00 with a room tax line of $26.28. The room line is adjusted by $30.00 and the room tax line by $3.60 ($30.00 multiplied by 12%), two adjustments in all.
- **Duplicate incidental.** Folio line 14 is a $36.50 restaurant charge on 9 May and line 15 repeats it with the same charge code, amount and date. Line 15 is a duplicate posting and is removed in full: $36.50.
- **Resort fee after check-out.** A guest checked out on 3 August and the folio shows a resort fee and its tax with a business date of 4 August. Both lines are removed in full, each by its own adjustment.
